achievements.name: Her Gift
achievements.description: They used her gift against her.

achievements.name: So Much Time
achievements.description: It will be okay. You have so, so much time.

achievements.name: Satisfactory
achievements.description: Satisfactory numbers, but we are going to have to let you go.

achievements.name: Unyielding Yes
achievements.description: Yes to everything, to all of it, the unyielding yes.

achievements.name: Noble and Futile
achievements.description: A noble and futile effort, best of luck.

achievements.name: Rewarded
achievements.description: The devotion, the commitment, it will surely be rewarded, it must be.

achievements.name: Both Pieces
achievements.description: And then, as both pieces failed to merge, an insight.

achievements.name: Your Moment
achievements.description: You were not ready, but it was your moment all the same.

achievements.name: Inward
achievements.description: In spite of these failures, I invite you inward still.

achievements.name: What is Needed
achievements.description: He who is drawn simply to what is needed, to what is not realized.
